# 2012 schema

All numeric columns are integers, but largest payroll values do not fit into R's 32-bit integer data type, so we use double type for all payroll columns.

Which columns overlap across datasets?

```{r}

columns <- ls("cbp") |>
  grepv("raw", x = _) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(\(k) {
    cols <- get("cbp", k) |>
      read_csv(n_max = 1) |>
      names()
    x <- data.frame(column = cols)
    x[[k]] <- TRUE
    x
  }) |>
  reduce(\(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "column"))

columns

columns %>%
  filter(raw_2012_us & raw_2012_st & raw_2012_co) %>%
  pull(column)



```
